narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Dividing always makes things smaller, so six divided by one quarter is less than six.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But how many quarters fit in six? There are four in every whole.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>That is far more than six.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>A divisor above one gives a smaller quotient. A divisor between zero and one gives a greater quotient.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Is eight divided by one half greater or less than eight?
